```{r helper functions and data}
# prolific codes in surveys were not properly assigned, so manually replace them
participant_code_replacements <- function(x, y) {
  # x is the prolific ID that we use to replace participant codes
  # y is the given participant code
  case_when(
    x == '56e130548b1c33000a388671' ~ 'VATZ46',
    x == '6287f4819c5fc8c4d48cc885' ~ 'AVX9QE',
    x == '601d69a993d94008fb2b25dc' ~ 'YWTGUB',
    x == '650464007006929ee0cd9695' ~ 'ZWTG94',
    x == '614ce6a7a33bac955957f7a6' ~ 'TPZZQA',
    x == '6317511c1dd0acb82cf4b131' ~ 'VQWK3M',
    x == '5e3ae8e5ebfb032f9058ef33' ~ 'KB39HV',
    x == '6554d0515dc2a90a0f6b3ae3' ~ 'VNPHMU',
    x == '5ec59e86c9569f5e8000717b' ~ 'ZN3EYY',
    x == '5ee834d45f0f48129a79b683' ~ 'UGED4M',
    .default = y
  ) %>% return()
}
# drop these participant codes -- clarify _why_ with Austin
participant_code_drops <- c('a43n36','a6punv','84z39x','9eemkf','7wgznu','xx43nc')

# affective numeric values
numeric_affect <- function(x) case_when(
        x == "Very slightly or not at all" ~ 0,
        x == "A little" ~ 1,
        x == "Moderately" ~ 2,
        x == "Quite a bit" ~ 3,
        x == "Extremely" ~ 4, 
        .default = NA)
calculate_affect <- function(x, affect_cols) {
  # x : data frame/tibble
  # affect_cols : list of characters denoting which columns to use
  
  x %>%
    select(paste0('panas_', affect_cols)) %>%
    rowSums(na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    return()
}
```

# Notes for Austin
- Why do we drop the following codes? `'a43n36','a6punv','84z39x','9eemkf','7wgznu','xx43nc'`
- Survey completion time: we were using `Duration (in seconds)_pre + Duration (in seconds)_post` to calculate survey completion time, but we should be using `intake` and `pretreatment` survey completion times
- Gold star $n$: 835


# Attrition
```{r load attrition data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# read raw data
intake <- read_csv("./Status Study 12-12-selected/intake.csv")
pretreat <- read_csv("./Status Study 12-12-selected/pre.csv")
posttreat <- read_csv("./Status Study 12-12-selected/post.csv")

total_n <- nrow(intake)
consent_drop <- intake %>% filter(Consent == 'No, I do NOT consent') %>% nrow()
jive_drop <-
  intake %>% filter((platforms_jive == 'A lot') |
                      (platforms_jive == 'Some')) %>% nrow()
device_drop <- intake %>%
  filter((download_apple == 'No, I am NOT') | (download_android == 'No, I am NOT')) %>%
  nrow()

download_drop <- intake %>%
  filter((download_apple == 'No, I am NOT') | (download_android == 'No, I am NOT')) %>%
  nrow()

image_drop <- intake %>%
  filter(screen_image != 3.0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(screen_image)) %>%
  nrow()

age_drop <- intake %>%
  filter(age < 18) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>% 
  nrow()

us_drop <- intake %>%
  filter(state == "I do not reside in the United States") %>%
  nrow()

forced_attrit <- consent_drop + jive_drop + device_drop + download_drop + image_drop + age_drop + us_drop

intake_completes <- intake %>%
  filter(!is.na(participant_code)) %>%
  nrow()

total_attrit_intake <- total_n - intake_completes - forced_attrit

pretreat_n <- pretreat %>% nrow()
attrit_intake_pretreat <- intake_completes - pretreat_n

pretreat_completes <- pretreat %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Q111_Page Submit`)) %>%
  nrow()

posttreat_n <- posttreat %>% nrow()

attrit_pre_post <- pretreat_completes - posttreat_n

posttreat_completes <- posttreat %>%
  filter(Progress >= 93) %>%
  nrow()


```

## Attrition through full study
```{r attrition through study, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}

# sankey diagram should have columns x, node, next_x, next_node
nodes <- tribble(
  ~node, ~stage,
  'Started intake', 1,
  'Finished intake', 2,
  'Did not finish intake', 2,
  'Dropped during download', 3,
  'Started pre-treat' , 3,
  'Finished pre-treat' , 4,
  'Did not finish pre-treat' , 4,
  'Started post-treat' , 5,
  'Lost during newsfeed', 5,
  'Finished post-treat', 6
  ) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = 'node_index') %>%
  mutate(node_index = as.numeric(node_index) - 1) %>%
  mutate(stage = as.character(stage))

sankey_df <- tribble(
  ~'start', ~'end', ~'n',
  # 'Started intake', NA, total_n,
  'Started intake', 'Finished intake', intake_completes,
  'Started intake', 'Did not finish intake', total_n - intake_completes,
  'Finished intake', 'Dropped during download', attrit_intake_pretreat,
  'Finished intake', 'Started pre-treat', pretreat_n,
  'Started pre-treat', 'Finished pre-treat', pretreat_completes,
  'Started pre-treat', 'Did not finish pre-treat', pretreat_n - pretreat_completes,
  'Finished pre-treat', 'Started post-treat', posttreat_n,
  'Finished pre-treat', 'Lost during newsfeed', pretreat_completes,
  'Started post-treat', 'Finished post-treat', posttreat_completes,
  # 'Finished post-treat', NA, NA
) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c('start' = 'node')) %>%
  rename('start_index' = 'node_index') %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c('end' = 'node')) %>%
  rename('end_index' = 'node_index'
  ) %>%
  mutate(n = 1)

sankey_plot <- networkD3::sankeyNetwork(
  Links = sankey_df,
  Nodes = nodes,
  Source = "start_index",
  Target = "end_index",
  Value = "n",
  units = "TWh",
  NodeID = 'node',
  NodeGroup = 'stage',
  fontSize = 20,
  nodeWidth = 30,
  sinksRight = FALSE
)


saveNetwork(sankey_plot, "./sn1.html")
webshot::install_phantomjs()
webshot("sn1.html", "sn1.png", vwidth = 1500, vheight = 500)

```

# Data Quality Checks
```{r load survey data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# read in intake, pre-treatment, and post-treatment survey responses
intake <- read_csv('./Status Study 12-12-selected/intake.csv') %>%
  # filter(!is.na(participant_code)) %>% # drop participants without a participant code
  mutate(participant_code = participant_code_replacements(PROLIFIC_PID, participant_code)) %>%
  mutate(participant_code = str_to_lower(participant_code))

pretreat <- read_csv('./Status Study 12-12-selected/pre.csv') %>%
  mutate(treatment = str_ends(treatment_arm, 'treat'))

posttreat <- read_csv('./Status Study 12-12-selected/post.csv') %>%
  # turn PANAS variables into numbers
  mutate_at(vars(starts_with('panas_')), numeric_affect) %>%
  mutate(panas_neg = calculate_affect(., c('hostile', 'ashamed', 'upset', 'afraid'))) %>%
  mutate(panas_pos = calculate_affect(., c('active', 'attentive', 'alert', 'determined', 'inspired'))) %>%
  mutate(panas = panas_pos - panas_neg)


intake_new <- intake
pretreat_new <- pretreat
posttreat_new <- posttreat

# make a new race variable
intake_new <- intake_new %>%
  mutate(
    race_new = case_when(
      race == 'Hispanic,White' ~ 'Hispanic',
      race == 'Something else' ~ 'Mixed/other',
      str_count(race, ',') > 0 ~ 'Mixed/other',
      .default = race))

# make a new education variable
intake_new <- intake_new %>%
  select(participant_code, starts_with('educ_')) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with('educ_')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  rename(new_educ = value) %>%
  inner_join(intake_new, by = 'participant_code')
# convert social media platform usage to numeric
intake_new <- intake_new %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with('platforms_'),
                .fns = 
                  ~case_match(.,
                    'A lot' ~ 2,
                    'Some' ~ 1,
                    'Not at all' ~ 0,
                    .default = NA)
                )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(social_media_sum = sum(across(.cols = starts_with('platforms_')), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  # mutate(social_media_sum = . %>% select(starts_with('platforms_')) %>% rowSums(., na.rm = TRUE))
  mutate(
    social_media_high  = (social_media_sum >= 5)
  )

# convert intellectual humility to numeric
pretreat_new <- pretreat_new %>%
  mutate(across(contains('_ih_'),
                .fns = ~case_match(.,
                             'Not at all well'~ 0,
                             'Not too well'~ 1,
                             'Somewhat well'~ 2,
                             'Very well'~ 3,
                             'Extremely well'~ 4)
  )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pre_ih = sum(across(.cols = starts_with('pre_ih_')), na.rm = TRUE),
         pre_ih_binary = pre_ih/6 >= 3)

# calculate moderation of ideals
pretreat_new <- pretreat_new %>%
  mutate(across(contains('_policy_'),
                .fns = ~case_match(.,
                                  'Strongly agree' ~ 3,
                                  'Agree' ~ 2,
                                  'Somewhat agree' ~ 1,
                                  'Neither agree nor disagree' ~ 0,
                                  'Disagree' ~ 1,
                                  'Somewhat disagree' ~ 2,
                                  'Strongly disagree' ~ 3))) %>%
  mutate(
    extremity_pre = case_when(
      str_detect(treatment_arm, 'gc') ~ pre_policy_gc,
      str_detect(treatment_arm, 'imm') ~ pre_policy_imm
    )
  )


posttreat_new <- posttreat_new %>%
  mutate(across(contains('_ih_'),
                .fns = 
                  ~case_match(.,
                             'Not at all well'~ 0,
                             'Not too well'~ 1,
                             'Somewhat well'~ 2,
                             'Very well'~ 3,
                             'Extremely well'~ 4)
  )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(post_ih = sum(across(.cols = starts_with('post_ih_')), na.rm = TRUE))

# convert future usage
posttreat_new <- posttreat_new %>%
  mutate(future_use_n = case_match(future_use,
                                   'Very unlikely' ~ 1,
                                   'Somewhat unlikely' ~ 2,
                                   'Neither unlikely nor likely' ~ 3,
                                   'Somewhat likely' ~ 4,
                                   'Very likely' ~ 5,
                                   NA ~ NA))

# convert platform descriptions to numeric values

posttreat_new <- posttreat_new %>%
  mutate(engaging = case_match(desc_platform_engaging,
            'Not at all' ~ 5,
            'Very little' ~ 4,
            'Some' ~ 3,
            'Quite a bit' ~ 2,
            'A great deal' ~ 1,
            NA ~ NA),
         toxic = case_match(desc_platform_toxic,
            'Not at all' ~ 1,
            'Very little' ~ 2,
            'Some' ~ 3,
            'Quite a bit' ~ 4,
            'A great deal' ~ 5,
            NA ~ NA),
         exhausting = case_match(desc_platform_exhausting,
            'Not at all' ~ 1,
            'Very little' ~ 2,
            'Some' ~ 3,
            'Quite a bit' ~ 4,
            'A great deal' ~ 5,
            NA ~ NA)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(platforms = mean(c(engaging, toxic, exhausting), na.rm = TRUE))

posttreat_new <- posttreat_new %>%
  mutate(polite = case_match(desc_users_polite,
            'Not at all' ~ 5,
            'Very little' ~ 4,
            'Some' ~ 3,
            'Quite a bit' ~ 2,
            'A great deal' ~ 1,
            NA ~ NA),
         aggressive = case_match(desc_users_aggressive,
            'Not at all' ~ 1,
            'Very little' ~ 2,
            'Some' ~ 3,
            'Quite a bit' ~ 4,
            'A great deal' ~ 5,
            NA ~ NA),
         tolerant = case_match(desc_users_tolerant,
            'Not at all' ~ 1,
            'Very little' ~ 2,
            'Some' ~ 3,
            'Quite a bit' ~ 4,
            'A great deal' ~ 5,
            NA ~ NA)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(users = mean(c(polite, aggressive, tolerant), na.rm = TRUE),
         users_b = mean(c(polite, tolerant), na.rm = TRUE))

posttreat_new <- posttreat_new %>%
  mutate(comfort = case_match(comfort_sharing,
                              "Not at all comfortable" ~ 1,
                               "Slightly comfortable" ~ 2,
                               "Moderately comfortable" ~ 3,
                               "Very comfortable" ~ 4,
                               "Extremely comfortable" ~ 5,
                               NA ~ NA))

posttreat_new <- posttreat_new %>%
    mutate(across(contains('_policy_'),
                .fns = ~case_match(.,
                                  'Strongly agree' ~ 3,
                                  'Agree' ~ 2,
                                  'Somewhat agree' ~ 1,
                                  'Neither agree nor disagree' ~ 0,
                                  'Disagree' ~ 1,
                                  'Somewhat disagree' ~ 2,
                                  'Strongly disagree' ~ 3)))

survey_df_new <- posttreat_new %>%
  inner_join(pretreat_new, by = 'participant_code', suffix = c('_post', '_pre')) %>%
  inner_join(intake_new %>% filter(!is.na(participant_code)), # drop participants without a participant code
             by = 'participant_code') %>%
  # drop participants in the code drop list
  filter(!(participant_code %in% participant_code_drops)) %>%
  # make a variable for assigned SMA condition
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    str_ends(treatment_arm, 'pc') ~ 'pure_control',
    str_ends(treatment_arm, 'treat') ~ 'treat',
    str_detect(treatment_arm, 'control') ~ 'control',
    .default = NA
  )) %>%
  mutate(delta_ih = post_ih - pre_ih) %>%
  mutate(ingroup_therm_pre = (pid3 == Party1) * pre_therm_1 + (pid3 != Party1) * pre_therm_2,
         outgroup_therm_pre = (pid3 == Party1) * pre_therm_2 + (pid3 != Party1) * pre_therm_1) %>%
  mutate(ingroup_therm_pre = ifelse(pid3 %in% c('Democrat', 'Republican'), ingroup_therm_pre, NA),
         outgroup_therm_pre = ifelse(pid3 %in% c('Democrat', 'Republican'), outgroup_therm_pre, NA)) %>%
  mutate(ingroup_therm_post = (pid3 == Party1) * post_therm_1 + (pid3 != Party1) * post_therm_2,
         outgroup_therm_post = (pid3 == Party1) * post_therm_2 + (pid3 != Party1) * post_therm_1) %>%
  mutate(ingroup_therm_post = ifelse(pid3 %in% c('Democrat', 'Republican'), ingroup_therm_post, NA),
         outgroup_therm_post = ifelse(pid3 %in% c('Democrat', 'Republican'), outgroup_therm_post, NA)) %>%
  mutate(outgroup_therm_change = outgroup_therm_post - outgroup_therm_pre,
         ingroup_therm_change = ingroup_therm_post - ingroup_therm_pre,
         affective_polarization = (ingroup_therm_change - outgroup_therm_change)/100) %>%
  mutate(
    extremity_post = case_when(
      str_detect(treatment_arm, 'gc') ~ post_policy_1,
      str_detect(treatment_arm, 'imm') ~ post_policy_2
    ),
    extremity_post_less_pre = extremity_post - extremity_pre
  ) %>%
  mutate(mc_correct_treat = (condition == 'treat') * (manip_check == 'The degree to which users respectfully engage with and learn from differing opinions.'),
         mc_correct_control = (condition == 'control') * (manip_check == 'The degree to which the user is "popular", or the degree to which they are able to achieve "likes".'),
         mc_correct_pure_control = (condition == 'pure_control') * (manip_check == 'There were no user badges on the platform.')) %>%
  mutate(mc_correct = mc_correct_treat + mc_correct_control + mc_correct_pure_control)

survey_df <- survey_df_new

```

```{r load engagement data, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
posts <- read_csv('./Status Study 12-12-selected/participant-export.csv') %>% 
  bind_rows(read_csv('./Status Study 12-12-selected/export-deleted.csv')) %>%
  filter(participantCode %in% survey_df$participant_code) %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(
    str_ends(treatmentArm, 'pc') ~ 'pure_control',
    str_ends(treatmentArm, 'treat') ~ 'treat',
    str_detect(treatmentArm, 'control') ~ 'control',
    .default = NA
  )) %>%
  mutate(ih = postOrCommentText %in% ih_posts)

likes <- posts %>%
  filter(participantLiked == 1)

dislikes <- posts %>%
  filter(participantDisliked == 1)


count_tokens <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tokenize_words() %>%
    sapply(., FUN = length) %>%
    return()
}
content <- posts %>%
  filter(userContent == 1) %>%
  mutate(length = count_tokens(postOrCommentText)) %>%
  mutate(this_is_a_comment = (parentPost != 'N/A'),
         this_is_a_post = (parentPost == 'N/A'))


post_vader_df <- vader::vader_df(content$postOrCommentText) %>%
  select(compound, pos, neg) %>%
  rename(sent_pos = pos,
         sent_neg = neg,
         sent = compound)
content_vader <- content %>%
  bind_cols(post_vader_df) %>%
  select(participantCode, sent_pos, sent_neg, sent)




survey_df <- survey_df %>%
  left_join(likes %>%
              group_by(participantCode) %>%
              mutate(total_likes = n()) %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              group_by(participantCode, ih) %>%
              summarize(ih_likes = n(),
                        total_likes = mean(total_likes),
                        p_likes_ih = ih_likes/total_likes) %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              filter(ih == 1) %>%
              select(-ih), by = c('participant_code' = 'participantCode')) %>%
  left_join(dislikes %>%
              group_by(participantCode) %>%
              mutate(total_dislikes = n()) %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              group_by(participantCode, ih) %>%
              summarize(ih_dislikes = n(),
                        total_dislikes = mean(total_dislikes),
                        p_dislikes_ih = ih_dislikes/total_dislikes) %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              filter(ih == 1) %>%
              select(-ih), by = c('participant_code' = 'participantCode')) %>%
  left_join(content_vader %>%
  group_by(participantCode) %>%
  summarize(sent_pos = mean(sent_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
            sent_neg = mean(sent_neg, na.rm = TRUE),
            sent = mean(sent, na.rm = TRUE)), by = c('participant_code' = 'participantCode')) %>%
  mutate(ih_likes = replace_na(ih_likes, 0),
         p_likes_ih = replace_na(p_likes_ih, 0),
         total_likes = replace_na(total_likes, 0),
         ih_dislikes = replace_na(ih_dislikes, 0),
         p_dislikes_ih = replace_na(p_dislikes_ih, 0),
         total_dislikes = replace_na(total_dislikes, 0))

all_dwell <- posts %>%
  group_by(participantCode) %>%
  summarize(total_dwell_time = sum(dwellTimeInSeconds))

ih_dwell <- posts %>%
  group_by(participantCode, ih) %>%
  summarize(ih_dwell_time = sum(dwellTimeInSeconds)) %>%
  group_by(participantCode) %>%
  mutate(total_dwell_time = sum(ih_dwell_time),
         prop_dwell_time_ih = ih_dwell_time/total_dwell_time) %>%
  filter(ih == 1) %>%
  select(-ih)

survey_df <- survey_df %>%
  left_join(ih_dwell, by = c('participant_code' = 'participantCode'))
```

## Demographic/Balance checks

```{r demog and balance checks, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

demogs_plot <- function(col, factor_list = NULL, title = NA) {
  if(!is.null(factor_list)) {
    survey_df <- survey_df %>%
      mutate_at(.vars = c(col), .funs = function(x) factor(x, levels = factor_list))
  }
  if(col == 'age') {
  p <- ggplot(survey_df) +
      geom_histogram(aes_string(x = col, fill = 'condition'), position = 'identity', alpha = 0.5, stat = 'count')
  p_value <- min(ks.test(survey_df[survey_df$condition == 'treat', ]$age,
                         survey_df[survey_df$condition == 'control', ]$age)$p.value,
                 ks.test(survey_df[survey_df$condition == 'treat', ]$age,
                         survey_df[survey_df$condition == 'pure_control',]$age)$p.value,
                 ks.test(survey_df[survey_df$condition == 'pure_control',]$age,
                         survey_df[survey_df$condition == 'control',]$age)$p.value
                 )
  }
  else {
    p <- ggplot(survey_df) +
      geom_histogram(aes_string(x = col, fill = 'condition'), position = 'dodge2', stat = 'count')
    p_value <- survey_df %>%
      group_by(condition, (!!as.symbol(col))) %>%
      count() %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = 'condition', names_from = col, values_from = 'n') %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      column_to_rownames('condition') %>%
      as.matrix() %>%
      chisq.test() %>%
      .$p.value
  }
  p <- p +
    theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste0('Histogram of `', title, '`'),
         subtitle = paste0('#Missing values: ', is.na(survey_df[col]) %>% sum()),
         caption = paste0('Min p-value from KS/Chi^2 test between groups: ', round(p_value, 4)),
         x = title)
  return(p)
}
```

# Main Hypothesis Tests
```{r main ttest code, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
main_hypothesis_test <- function(df,
                                 outcome,
                                 main_condition = 'treat',
                                 contrast_condition = 'control',
                                 display_plot = FALSE,
                                 title = '',
                                 return_object = FALSE) {
  # isolate data for main group and contrast group
  outcome_main_group <- df %>%
    filter(condition == main_condition) %>%
    .[outcome] %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    pull(.)

  outcome_contrast_group <- df %>%
    filter(condition == contrast_condition) %>%
    .[outcome] %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    pull(.)

  # run t test comparing these two groups
  ttest_results <- t.test(
    x = outcome_main_group,
    y = outcome_contrast_group,
    alternative = 'two.sided',
    var.equal = FALSE
  )
  # ttest_estimate <- ttest_results$
  ttest_pvalue <- ttest_results$p.value
  ttest_cohens_d <- effsize::cohen.d(outcome_main_group,
                                     outcome_contrast_group)$estimate

  # make ttest plot
  n_stars <- ''
  if(ttest_pvalue < 0.05) { n_stars <- '*'}
  else if(ttest_pvalue < 0.01) { n_stars <- '**'}
  else if(ttest_pvalue < 0.001) { n_stars <- '***' }
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_bar(aes(x = outcome_main_group, y = ..prop.., fill = main_condition), alpha = 0.5, position = 'identity') +
    geom_bar(aes(x = outcome_contrast_group, y = ..prop.., fill = contrast_condition), alpha = 0.5, position = 'identity') +
    geom_density(aes(x = outcome_main_group, fill = main_condition), alpha = 0.5, position = 'identity') +
    geom_density(aes(x = outcome_contrast_group, fill = contrast_condition), alpha = 0.5, position = 'identity') +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(outcome_main_group), linetype = main_condition), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(outcome_contrast_group), linetype = contrast_condition), linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = outcome,
         y = 'density',
         title = paste0(title, ': ', outcome, n_stars),
         subtitle = paste0('(p=', round(ttest_pvalue, 3), ', D=', round(ttest_cohens_d, 3), ')'),
         fill = 'Contrast groups',
         linetype = 'Contrast groups'
         )

  if(ttest_pvalue < 0.05) {
    p <- p +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = 'bold'),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(face = 'bold'))
  }
return_list <- list('contrast' = paste(main_condition, 'vs', contrast_condition),
                    'ttest' = ttest_results,
                    'p.value' = ttest_pvalue,
                    'cohen.d' = ttest_cohens_d,
                    'plot' = p)
  # if you should display the plot, make the plot and display it
  if(display_plot) print(p)
  if(return_object) return(return_list)
}

subgroup_hypothesis_test <- function(df,
                                 outcome,
                                 subgroup_col,
                                 subgroup_rhs,
                                 main_condition = 'treat',
                                 contrast_condition = 'control',
                                 display_plot = FALSE,
                                 title = '',
                                 return_object = FALSE) {
  result <- main_hypothesis_test(
    df %>% filter(.data[[subgroup_col]] == subgroup_rhs),
    outcome,
    main_condition,
    contrast_condition,
    display_plot,
    title = paste0(title, subgroup_col, '=', subgroup_rhs),
    return_object = TRUE
  )
  if (return_object) return(result)
}

multiple_subgroups_htest <- function(df,
                                 outcome,
                                 subgroup_cols,
                                 subgroup_rhss,
                                 main_condition = 'treat',
                                 contrast_condition = 'control',
                                 display_plot = FALSE,
                                 title = '',
                                 return_object = FALSE)
  {
  row_names <- paste0(subgroup_cols, '=', subgroup_rhss)
  subgroup_results <- data.frame('contrast' = rep(NA, length(row_names)),
                                 'ttest' = rep(NA, length(row_names)),
                                 'p.value' = rep(NA, length(row_names)),
                                 'cohen.d' = rep(NA, length(row_names)),
                                 'plot' = rep(NA, length(row_names)),
                                 row.names = paste0(subgroup_cols, '=', subgroup_rhss))
  for(index in 1:length(subgroup_cols)) {
    sg_result <- subgroup_hypothesis_test(survey_df,
                           outcome = outcome,
                           subgroup_col = subgroup_cols[index],
                           subgroup_rhs = subgroup_rhss[index],
                           display_plot = display_plot,
                           return_object = TRUE)
    subgroup_results[paste0(subgroup_cols[index], '=', subgroup_rhss[index]), ] <- sg_result
  }
  subgroup_results$outcome <- outcome
  subgroup_results$subgroup <- rownames(subgroup_results)
  rownames(subgroup_results) <- NULL
  if(return_object) return(subgroup_results)
}
```

## Subgroup Analyses
```{r subgroup, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

subgroup_cols <- c('pre_ih_binary',
                   'pre_ih_binary',
                   'social_media_high',
                   'social_media_high',
                   'pid3',
                   'pid3')
subgroup_rhss <- list(TRUE, FALSE, 1, 0, 'Democrat', 'Republican')

subgroup <- lapply(X = list('panas_neg', 'panas_pos', 'panas', 'delta_ih', 'affective_polarization', 'extremity_post_less_pre'),
       function(x) multiple_subgroups_htest(
  df = survey_df,
  outcome = x,
  subgroup_cols = subgroup_cols,
  subgroup_rhss = subgroup_rhss,
  main_condition = 'treat',
  contrast_condition = 'control',
  display_plot = FALSE,
  title = '',
  return_object = TRUE
)) %>%
  bind_rows()

subgroup %>%
  filter(p.value <= 0.05) %>%
  select(p.value, cohen.d, outcome, subgroup) %>%
  mutate(stars = case_when(
    p.value <= 0.001 ~ '***',
    p.value <= 0.01 ~ '**',
    p.value <= 0.05 ~ '*'
  )) %>%
  mutate(cohen.d = paste0(round(cohen.d, 3), stars)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = 'subgroup', names_from = 'outcome', values_from = 'cohen.d') %>%
  column_to_rownames('subgroup') %>%
  pander::pander(caption = 'Rows represent subgroups, columns represent outcome, and entries represent effect size. p<0.05*, p<0.01**, p<0.001***')
```
